newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to act against excessive forex moves -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to act against excessive forex moves -- MOF.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Monday that Japan would act decisively against excessive movements in the foreign exchange market.
"The recent movements of the yen (against the dollar) have clearly been overdone, and I am concerned about it." Mitsuzuka told journalists and business executives.
"(The monetary authorities) will act decisively at an appropriate time against such excessive moves in the foreign exchange market," he added.
Currency intervention could be an option to deal with the excessive forex moves, Mitsuzuka said.
He said that Japan has been in close contact with U.S. authorities but declined to comment further.
